blocks.text: MANILA< Philippines — House Deputy Speaker Janette Garin of Iloilo on Saturday defended the House of Representatives’ realignment of P9 billion from the Department of Health’s (DOH) proposed 2027 budget, citing the agency’s slow utilization of existing funds. Speaking at the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City, Garin, a former health secretary, said the House transferred P5 billion from the DOH’s immunization program and P4 billion from its health facilities improvement program to the agency’s medical assistance program. While welcoming criticism regarding the adjustments, Garin said the public must understand the rationale behind the realignments. READ: Garin backs […]...
